messages:
nightly-eval-bot: [ALERT] 03:07 UTC composition_tests_v3 failed on redwood-v2-7b-quant4; coherence delta = -8.3% vs baseline. failing cohorts: long-instruction, nested-step. run: nightly/2026-03-19-03:00

anya: saw the alert, how bad is this for shipping features? is this just the quant4 build or also fp16?

devon: pinging eng-ml oncall & runtime. @matt can you take a quick look? marking initial severity: SEV-2 until we confirm customer impact.

matt: grabbing logs now. quick summary: failures clustered on prompts with >3 instruction layers and heavy list enumerations. attaching a failing prompt snippet below:
```
You are an assistant that must perform stepwise extraction:
1) read the nested instructions
2) return a numbered list of actions, no extra commentary
3) if ambiguous, return "clarify:" followed by a single question
Input: 
- "If the user says 'when' follow rule A, else rule B'"
```

rachel: fwiw we rolled a quant config tweak yesterday at 02:10 UTC for the quant4 optimizer: kv_cache_sparsify=true and attention_k_split=2. That landed in model-builds pipeline for redwood-v2-7b-quant4.

anya: timeline fits. nightly job started at 03:00 so new artifact could be in play. can someone reproduce locally?

matt: repro steps I used (worked locally):
```
# docker image: rwinf/redwood-runtime:canary-quant4-20260319
python reproduce_eval.py --model redwood-v2-7b-quant4 --suite composition_tests_v3 --prompt-file samples/failing_prompt.txt --seed 42 --max-tokens 256
```
I see the same coherence failures and some truncated lists (outputs cut mid-item). logits dump shows spike at token idx ~128 causing early termination.

devon: who owns the quant kernel stack? @siva in eng-runtime? tagging for triage.

siva: ack. I'm instrumenting attention kernels now. initial hunch: kv_cache_sparsify interacts poorly with the attention splitting codepath for seq>128 on this model shape. I'll try forcing fallback to fp16 attention kernel to see if it mitigates.

matt: quick experiment: forced fp16 attention path locally -> reran same prompt -> output restored, lists complete, coherence delta back within noise.

rachel: that aligns with the profile change; kv_cache_sparsify saves memory but may change buffer layout assumptions for the split kernel.

anya: immediate actions proposed:
- rollback quant config kv_cache_sparsify=true for redwood-v2-7b-quant4 in model-builds (devon)
- run canary on dedicated pool for composition_tests_v3 and a handful of customer-like prompts (matt + siva)
- instrument attention kernel to add assert/metrics around buffer layout and sequence>128 cases (siva)
- notify product + CS (laura) and create incident if rollback doesn't clear alerts (anya/devon)

devon: I can revert the config in the build pipeline and trigger a retrain artifact. ETA: 30m to push revert + canary job scheduled.

laura: thanks for the tag. I'll draft a short note to CS and product about possible regressions for hosted users this morning; will wait for canary result before escalating.

nightly-eval-bot: note: after revert-test (local), small evaluation on a 200-sample subset: coherence diff went from -8.3% to -0.4% vs baseline. full nightly will re-run in ~45m.

matt: marking reproduction verified locally, setting provisional severity P1 for now because customer-facing coherence SLO breached in nightly. actual incident channel only if canary fails.

siva: I'll push an instrumentation build and a hotfix that forces fp16 attention for the problematic path as a safety fallback. if that looks good we'll roll into the next canary artifact.

anya: thanks team. keep updates in this thread. please add short notes to the eval ticket so we have a trace (ticket: EVAL-4219). :thumbsup:

devon: opening a lightweight incident channel in 10 if canary fails. otherwise we'll close this thread after a green run.

matt: +1. confirmed green on local fp16 fallback. waiting on ci canary results.

nightly-eval-bot: [UPDATE] 03:48 UTC canary run complete: composition_tests_v3 canary (n=500) -> coherence delta now -0.2%. alert cleared.

anya: closing loop: rollback + fp16 fallback fixed the nightly. siva to follow up with a permanent patch for safe kernel interaction. writeup + postmortem if we see recurrence.

laura: sending heads-up to CS.

devon: closing unless new failures pop up. :white_check_mark:
